commands.name: spell list
commands.label: List spells
commands.description: The loaded spells: name, school, mana and the vessels that hold them. The filter matches name, school or category.

args.name: filter
args.description: Part of a name, a school (fire, frost) or a category.

commands.name: spell info
commands.label: Spell details
commands.description: One spell's details: school, mana, cast time, cooldown, delivery and each effect.

args.name: spell
args.description: The spell's name or id, such as Flame Bolt.

examples.explanation: Fireball's burst and its two effects.

commands.name: spell editor
commands.label: Spell editor
commands.description: Opens the spell editor window: build a spell from a template, see its stat block, grade, zone and mana as you go, and save it to your own spell pack.

commands.name: spell give
commands.label: Give vessels
commands.description: Gives a player scrolls, potions or wands. For testing and for rewards.

args.name: vessel
args.description: The vessel's id, such as scroll_flame_bolt, or its item id.

commands.name: spell cast
commands.label: Cast any spell
commands.description: Casts a spell with no vessel, mana or cooldown, at what you look at or at a named player. For testing.

args.name: spell
args.description: The spell's id, such as flame_bolt.

examples.explanation: A Prismatic Spray at what you look at.

commands.name: spell cooldowns
commands.label: Cooldowns
commands.description: Each spell's cooldown left. Another player's needs spellcrafter.admin.

commands.name: spell debug
commands.label: Debug my casts
commands.description: Your own casts print their rider report, seed and rolls in chat.

commands.name: spell reload
commands.label: Reload spells
commands.description: Reloads spell packs, vessels, frequencies and settings, and logs what changed.
